statement: The distributed test harness stamps the run's source fingerprint into every report it writes: buildReportMetadata in test/distributed/run.js (the single metadata owner, called once per written report) records metadata.srcFingerprint and metadata.srcFingerprintAlgo from the fingerprint the run already computes for its docker config, with a typed absent sentinel when no fingerprinted config exists, so a memory-soak report can be bound to the frozen release digest by the release verification producer's fail-closed fingerprint oracle; every other report field, the report writer, its property suite and the serialization-degrade behaviour are unchanged and no verdict, budget or cadence changes. Proven deterministically in the existing run.js suite: red on HEAD (metadata lacks srcFingerprint), green after.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

buildReportMetadata in test/distributed/run.js is the single owner of the stamp; the value is the fingerprint the run already computes (runConfig.docker.srcFingerprint and its algorithm), with a typed absent sentinel when no fingerprinted config exists; no verdict, budget, cadence or scenario logic changes.
Every other report field, the report writer, its property suite and the serialization-degrade behaviour are byte-for-byte unchanged.

Proof is a deterministic scenario in the existing run.js suite, red on HEAD (metadata lacks srcFingerprint) and green after, with the unchanged run.js and report-writer suites as controls that must stay green.
